text:
Predicates:
OlympicGames(x) ::: x is an Olympic game.
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
LastOlympicGames(x) ::: x was the last Olympic games.
Location(x, y) ::: x was held in location y.
UnitedStates(x) ::: x is the United States.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in event y.
Tokyo ::: Tokyo is a location.
WorldChampionships(x) ::: x is a world championship.
Premises:
OlympicGames(x) ∧ SportingEvent(x) ::: The Olympic games is a sporting event.
LastOlympicGames(x) ∧ Location(x, Tokyo) ::: The last Olympic games was in Tokyo.
UnitedStates(y) ∧ WonMostMedals(y, x) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
SportingEvent(y) ::: The world championships is a sporting event.
